component.name: FastFlowLM
component.summary: The fastest, most efficient LLM inference on NPUs

description.p: FastFlowLM is an NPU-optimized runtime that delivers fast, efficient language model inference on tile-structured neural processing units. It provides an Ollama-style developer experience with quick installation, instant token streaming, and support for context windows up to 256k tokens.
It supports multiple AI modalities including reasoning models, vision, audio, and embeddings, with general availability for AMD Ryzen AI NPUs.
